section.15: The Book of Shortening the Prayer When Traveling

15.name_native: The Book of Shortening the Prayer When Traveling

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Qatadah said:"I heard Muas- bin Salamah-say: 'I said to Ibn 'Abbas: How should I pray in Makkah if I do not pray in congregation? He said: Two rak'ahs, the sunnah of Abu Al-Qasim
